company_profile.tech_level: Moderate - Clio for practice management, basic automation
company_profile.description: Boutique commercial law firm with 18 fee earners specializing in corporate M&A, employment law, and commercial contracts. Known for responsive service and practical advice. Primarily serves mid-market Dutch and international companies.

executive_summary.key_insight: Morrison & Clarke has strong client relationships but partners and associates lose 15-20% of billable time to admin tasks that AI can automate. Time tracking capture alone is leaving an estimated EUR 80,000-120,000/year in unbilled work. The firm is well-positioned for AI adoption given existing Clio infrastructure.

not_recommended.title: Enterprise Document Management (iManage/NetDocuments)
not_recommended.reason: At 18 fee earners, these systems cost EUR 500-1,500/user/month and require dedicated IT. SharePoint + Clio integration is sufficient for your scale.

not_recommended.title: Full AI-Autonomous Drafting
not_recommended.reason: Professional liability requires human review on all client work. Use AI for first drafts with mandatory lawyer review.

not_recommended.title: Custom Billing System Build
not_recommended.reason: Trust accounting and LEDES compliance are complex. Clio handles this well - don't rebuild.

findings.title: 10-15% of Billable Time Goes Unrecorded
findings.description: Partners and associates routinely forget to capture all time spent on client matters - quick calls, email review, brief research. At average billable rates of EUR 250/hour across 18 fee earners, this represents EUR 80K-120K in lost annual revenue. Industry best practice is AI-assisted time capture from calendar, email, and document activity.
sources: Legal industry benchmarks - Clio Legal Trends Report 2025

findings.title: Document Drafting Takes 2-3x Longer Than Necessary
findings.description: Associates spend 3-5 hours drafting standard documents (NDAs, employment contracts, shareholder agreements) that could start from AI-generated first drafts in 15-30 minutes. With 40+ such documents monthly, junior time could be better spent on higher-value analysis.

findings.title: Client Intake Takes 2-4 Hours Per New Matter
findings.description: New client onboarding involves manual conflict checks, engagement letter drafting, KYC collection, and multiple email exchanges. Competitors using automated intake convert leads 40% faster. Your current process occasionally loses prospects to faster-responding firms.

value_created.description: Faster intake improves conversion of new prospects

findings.title: Contract Review in M&A Deals Is Labor-Intensive
findings.description: Due diligence on M&A transactions requires reviewing hundreds of contracts for key terms, risks, and anomalies. Associates spend 60-80% of their time on mechanical review tasks that AI can accelerate by 50-70%.
sources: Contract AI benchmarks - Luminance, Kira Systems case studies

findings.title: Email Drafting and Inbox Management Consumes Partner Time
findings.description: Partners spend 1-2 hours daily on email - drafting responses, summarizing threads for colleagues, and triaging inbox. AI email assistance can draft responses for review and summarize long chains, saving 30-40% of email time.

recommendations.title: Implement AI-Powered Time Capture
recommendations.description: Deploy AI time tracking that automatically captures billable time from calendar events, email activity, and document work. System suggests time entries for lawyer approval, recovering the 10-15% of billable hours currently lost.

why_it_matters.customer_value: More accurate billing means clients pay for actual work done - no more uncomfortable conversations about missed time or estimates.
why_it_matters.business_health: Immediate revenue recovery of 80K-120K annually. Utilization visibility helps identify capacity issues.

risk.description: Privacy concerns from lawyers about activity monitoring
risk.mitigation: Position as 'time suggestion' not 'surveillance' - lawyers approve all entries

risk.description: Integration with existing Clio may require setup time
risk.mitigation: Smokeball and Timeero have certified Clio integrations

enhance_with_ai.name: Smokeball
pros: Automatic time capture from all activity

connect_and_automate.approach: Build internal time capture using Microsoft Graph API + Claude API for activity-to-time-entry suggestions. The Graph API provides calendar, email, and document activity data; Claude classifies and suggests time entries.
cons: Accuracy improves over time with tuning

recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Your firm already runs on Clio and Microsoft 365 — both have strong APIs. Connecting them with Claude API captures billable time automatically without adding per-user SaaS fees that compound across 18 fee earners. The moderate complexity is well within reach with guided implementation.

net_scores.comparison_summary: Smokeball offers the best balance of proven ROI and low implementation risk. But custom is now viable at EUR 4-10K — especially if you want to avoid per-user SaaS fees that compound across 18 fee earners.

recommendations.title: Deploy AI Document Drafting Assistant
recommendations.description: Implement AI-powered first draft generation for standard legal documents. Associates describe what they need, AI produces a draft based on your templates and precedents, associate reviews and refines.

why_it_matters.customer_value: Faster turnaround on routine documents. Clients get drafts same-day instead of 2-3 day wait.
why_it_matters.business_health: Associates spend time on analysis and client advice rather than formatting. Enables more matters with same headcount.

risk.description: AI may produce errors requiring careful review
risk.mitigation: Mandatory lawyer review on ALL AI-drafted documents - never send without human approval
Use enterprise-grade AI with data processing agreements (Claude for Work, Microsoft Copilot)

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a RAG-based drafting assistant using Claude API with your firm's precedent library as the knowledge base. Upload templates and prior documents to a vector store, Claude generates first drafts contextualised to your style and clauses. AI coding tools make this a 3-4 week project for a developer.
pros: Deeply trained on YOUR documents and precedents
No per-user fees — Claude API scales by usage (~EUR 150/month)
Can integrate directly with SharePoint document library
Better legal-specific results than generic Copilot
cons: Requires initial document indexing and prompt engineering
No vendor support — you own the system

recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Start with Microsoft Copilot since you already have M365. At EUR 28/user/month, it's low-risk to pilot. If results are good after 3 months, evaluate a custom Claude-based system that trains on your actual precedent library — at EUR 5-12K it's now affordable and will produce better firm-specific output than any generic tool.

net_scores.comparison_summary: Start with Copilot (already in your M365 stack). But a custom Claude-based drafter trained on YOUR precedents is now EUR 5-12K and 4 weeks — worth evaluating after Copilot pilot if you want firm-specific quality.

recommendations.title: Automate Client Intake & Conflict Checking
recommendations.description: Implement digital intake forms, automated conflict-of-interest checking against your client database, and e-signature for engagement letters. New clients can onboard in hours instead of days.

why_it_matters.customer_value: Prospects experience modern, responsive service from first contact. Faster engagement means they can proceed with their matter sooner.
why_it_matters.business_health: Reduce intake admin time by 70%. Win more competitive pitches by responding first.

risk.description: Automated conflict checks may miss complex relationships
risk.mitigation: AI flags potential conflicts for partner review - never auto-clear

risk.description: Clients may prefer personal contact over digital forms
risk.mitigation: Offer both options - digital for speed, phone for preference

connect_and_automate.approach: Build intake portal using Typeform (or Tally.so) + Zapier + Clio API for automatic contact creation and conflict checking. Zapier handles orchestration, Clio API handles the data.
connect_and_automate.prerequisite: Requires Clio Grow or equivalent digital intake foundation
cons: Requires Clio Grow to be set up first
Less polished than native Clio UX

recommendations.recommendation_rationale: Your intake process is currently paper-based with no digital forms. You need a digital foundation first — Clio Grow provides native intake forms, conflict checking, and e-signature that integrates directly with your existing Clio Manage. Once this foundation is in place, you can wire AI automations on top.

net_scores.comparison_summary: Clio Grow's native integration with your existing Clio Manage still wins on UX and zero-friction setup. But at EUR 1.5-4K, custom is a viable alternative if you want a branded intake experience.
